newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney starts regional banks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - S. Barney starts regional banks.

text.p: -- Smith Barney initiated coverage of several regional bank stocks.
-- Smith Barney analyst Jacqueline Reeves initiated coverage of Marshall and Ilsley Corp as a buy.
-- Smith Barney said if Marshall and Ilsley became part of a larger company, shareholders could receive about $48 a share.
-- Smith Barney expects Marshall and Isley to earn $0.57 a share in the fourth quarter and $2.08 a share for the full year 1996.
-- Smith Barney also started coverage of Mercantile Bancorp as outperform.
-- Smith Barney said Mercantile's recently announced merger with Mark Twain Bancshares Inc will increase its market strength in several key areas and enhance its franchise value.
-- Smith Barney expects the Mercantile-Mark Twain deal to be dilutive to Mercantile's earnings by about one percent in 1997 and modestly accretive thereafter.
-- Smith Barney also initiated coverage of several other banks as neutral, including CNB Bancshares Inc, Commerce Bancshares Inc, Magna Group Inc and Old National Bancorp.
-- Smith Barney set a 12-month share price target of $39 for CNB. If CNB became part of a larger company, CNB shareholders could get about $44 a share.
-- Smith Barney sees Commerce Bancshare's market as key area for consolidation. The firm expects Commerce to earn $0.83 a share in the fourth quarter and $3.25 a share for the full year 1996.

-- Smith Barney set a $33 share price target for Magna Group. Smith Barney sees Magna Group's Missouri market as a key area for further consolidation. Magna shareholders could get $45 a share if the bank became part of a larger company.

-- Smith Barney expects Old National to raise its dividend by about six percent in the first quarter of 1997. The company is also expects to buy back shares over the next year. Smith Barney set a 12-month share price target of $39.
